note: CR-003 — the home cue feed, in order. THIS FILE IS THE CONTROL SURFACE: reorder `order` and rebuild, no code changes. It is also the intended data source for a future admin panel. Every slug must be on Cloudflare Stream (see src/data/cloudflare-stream-map.json) so it plays as a native <video> — a slug that isn't falls back to a YouTube iframe, which does not autoplay on iOS (cr-002-mobile-playback-qa.md). Run `npm run check:featured` after editing; it hard-fails on any cue missing from the Stream map. An empty order[] falls back to a date sort.
